name: Financial Considerations
excerpt: Financial Considerations include NPV, ROI, and payback period.
notes: Financial Considerations in project selection involve evaluating the Net Present Value (NPV), Return on Investment (ROI), and Payback Period of projects. These metrics help in assessing the financial viability and prioritization of projects.
context_summary:
- Includes NPV, ROI, and payback period
- Evaluates financial viability of projects
- Helps in prioritization of projects
